UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated user account profile with 13+ age verification state.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

fullName.description: User's display or full name (1 to 120 characters).

dateOfBirth.description: Optional ISO date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD) used for 13+ age verification.

ageVerified.description: Whether the user has confirmed they are at least 13 years old.

photoUrl.description: Optional HTTPS profile picture URL synced with Firebase Auth.

photoBase64.description: Optional Base64-encoded cropped avatar thumbnail uploaded from the device Photo Picker.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ProviderProfile.title: ProviderProfile
ProviderProfile.description: Private provider business draft and pending-review submission owned by a single user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the provider profile owner.

description.description: Optional short business description (up to 1200 characters).

categorySlug.description: Slug of the primary service subcategory.

categoryName.description: Human-readable name of the primary service subcategory.

businessAddress.description: Optional business street or neighbourhood address used for map placement (2 to 200 characters).

latitude.description: Optional geocoded latitude in [-90, 90] derived from the business address.

longitude.description: Optional geocoded longitude in [-180, 180] derived from the business address.

listingStatus.description: Client-editable listing state; public approval ('published') is server/admin controlled.

verificationStatus.description: Client-initialized verification status; only administrators can approve verification.

submittedAt.description: Server timestamp when the draft was submitted for review (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the draft was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the draft was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BookingRequest.title: BookingRequest
BookingRequest.description: Scheduled service booking request submitted by a customer and linked to a service provider's profile.

customerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer requesting the service.

customerName.description: Display name of the requesting customer (1 to 120 characters).

providerId.description: Document ID of the linked /providerProfiles/{providerId} document.

providerUserId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID of the linked service provider.

providerBusinessName.description: Snapshot business name of the linked provider profile (2 to 120 characters).

categorySlug.description: Slug of the booked service category.

categoryName.description: Human-readable name of the booked service category.

providerLocation.description: Business address or city/country summary of the provider (2 to 250 characters).

scheduledDate.description: Requested service date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

notes.description: Optional customer notes or job details (up to 600 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the booking request was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the booking request was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ProviderReview.title: ProviderReview
ProviderReview.description: Customer rating (1-5 stars) and written feedback stored per user and provider.

providerId.description: Document ID of the linked /providerProfiles/{providerId} document.

providerUserId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID of the reviewed service provider.

customerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reviewing user.

reviewerName.description: Display name of the reviewer (1 to 120 characters).

comment.description: Written feedback for the service provider (2 to 1000 characters).

bookingId.description: Optional related /bookings/{bookingId} identifier when reviewing after a booking.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was first submitted (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ProviderSubscription.title: ProviderSubscription
ProviderSubscription.description: Provider subscription plan tier, billing cadence, limits, and masked payment instrument.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the subscription owner.

providerId.description: Document ID of the linked /providerProfiles/{providerId} document.

paymentMethod.description: Tokenized/masked billing method used for the subscription.

amountCents.description: Server-validated plan charge in USD cents.

monthlyBookingLimit.description: Monthly booking quota enforced for the plan tier.

maxCategories.description: Maximum allowed service categories for the plan tier.

autoRenew.description: Whether the provider elected automatic renewal.

maskedInstrument.description: Optional non-sensitive masked payment instrument summary (never stores PAN or CVV).

verificationId.description: Required /financialVerifications/{verificationId} document ID for paid subscriptions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when subscription was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when subscription was last updated.

BillingPayment.title: BillingPayment
BillingPayment.description: Immutable provider billing checkout receipt and invoice record (masked instrument only).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the payer.

paymentMethod.description: Payment rail used for the checkout.

subtotalCents.description: Gross subtotal in USD cents prior to annual discount.

discountCents.description: 30% annual discount in USD cents (0 for monthly).

amountCents.description: Net charged amount in USD cents (subtotalCents - discountCents).

maskedInstrument.description: Non-sensitive masked payment summary without PAN/CVV/PIN.

invoiceNumber.description: Deterministic or generated uppercase invoice reference.

verificationId.description: Required /financialVerifications/{verificationId} audit proof for paid checkouts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the checkout record was created.

ProviderSecurityConfig.title: ProviderSecurityConfig
ProviderSecurityConfig.description: Owner-only 2FA enrollment metadata storing only SHA-256 fingerprint of encrypted key.

secretFingerprint.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 hash of the Android-Keystore-sealed TOTP secret.

FinancialVerification.title: FinancialVerification
FinancialVerification.description: Immutable append-only 2FA audit receipt combining Firebase Auth step-up re-authentication and TOTP verification.

ChatThread.title: ChatThread
ChatThread.description: Real-time pre-booking conversation thread between a customer and a service provider keyed deterministically as {providerId}__{customerId}.

participantIds.description: Two-element list [customerId, providerUserId] for scoped inbox queries.

CommunityMessage.title: CommunityMessage
CommunityMessage.description: Public real-time message shared across all signed-in Trolley users with 3-second server cooldown.

ChatRateLimit.title: ChatRateLimit
ChatRateLimit.description: Per-user server timestamp gate enforcing a mandatory 3-second cooldown between community messages.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user account and age-gate record.

/providerProfiles/{providerId}.description: Provider business profiles keyed by owner UID (private drafts and admin-published listings).

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Service booking requests linked between customerId and providerProfiles/{providerId}.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Customer ratings and feedback keyed deterministically as {providerId}__{customerId}.

/providerSubscriptions/{providerId}.description: Owner-only provider subscription tier, quotas, and renewal preferences.

/billingPayments/{paymentId}.description: Append-only immutable billing payment receipts and invoice ledger.

/providerSecurity/{providerId}.description: Owner-only provider 2FA enrollment state without raw secret exposure.

/financialVerifications/{verificationId}.description: Immutable Firebase Auth 2FA audit trail required before paid financial transactions.

/chatThreads/{threadId}.description: Real-time pre-booking conversation threads scoped strictly to participants.

/chatThreads/{threadId}/messages/{messag.description: Immutable participant-isolated chat messages for real-time messaging.

/communityMessages/{messageId}.description: Open real-time community chat messages for all signed-in users, protected by 3-second cooldown.
